JUDGMENT Brief Facts:
1. Accused persons namely Niranjan Kumar, Chandan Kumar, Visheshwar Paswan,
Kamla Devi and Seema have been facing trial for Charge under Sections 498A/304B/34 Indian Penal Code (hereinafter referred to as 'IPC') as Smt. Priyanka Kumari was married to accused Niranjan Kumar on 11.02.2016 and he, being husband alongwith co-accused persons namely Visheshwar Paswan (father-in-law);
Kamla Devi (mother-in-law), Chandan Kumar (brother-in-law/Jeth) and Smt. Seema (sister-in-law/Jethani) subjected Smt. Priyanka Kumari to cruelty and harassment for demand of dowry on various occasions due to which Smt. Priyanka Kumari had died under unnatural circumstances on 12.09.2019 at State v. Niranjan Kumar &
others her matrimonial house situated at H.No. 227, Veena Enclave, Nangloi, Delhi i.e. within seven years of her marriage.

Registration of FIR and investigation conducted:
2.

".
On receipt of this message, duty officer recorded the same in DD no.7A and assigned to ASI Bajrang, who alongwith HC Manish went to the spot i.e. H.No. 227, Veena Enclave, Nangloi, Delhi.
There they came to know that deceased Priyanka Kumari w/o Niranjan Kumar had committed suicide with the saree while hanging with ceiling fan.
At the spot, two pieces of green colour saree were lying on the bed.
They came to know that deceased was taken to SGM hospital, where she was declared 'brought dead'.
No suicide note was found at the spot.

During investigation, IO took two pieces of green colour saree,
one stool which was lying on the bed, sealed them with the seal of BS and seized them vide seizure memo.

During investigation, IO had recorded statement of mother of deceased Smt. Aanti Devi, wherein she has stated that she was having two sons and two daughters.
Her youngest daughter namely Priyanka/deceased got married with accused Niranjan Kumar on 11.02.2016 according to Hindu rites and ceremonies.
The deceased Priyanka was 8th pass and 25 years old at the time of her marriage.
Accused Niranjan Kumar was 12th pass.

After the marriage, Priyanka started residing with co-accused Niranjan Kumar at H.No. 227, Veena Enclave, near Sonia hospital, Nangloi Delhi, where parents-in-law, Jeth (brother-in-law) & Jethani (sister-in-law) of the deceased were also residing State vs Niranjan Kumar on 18 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154422755/
3 with them.
At the time of death of deceased, she was having pregnancy of 4-5 months.
After the marriage, accused Niranjan Kumar started demand of dowry.
Sometimes he demanded Rs. 3 lakhs and sometimes he demanded Rs. 5 lakhs.
She further stated that all the accused persons including sister of accused Niranjan namely Suman used to give beatings to Priyanka and also used to demand dowry.

They had given gold jewelery of Rs. 3 lakhs, ring and chain of accused Niranjan Kumar, one motorcycle, bed, 12 brass, one set of coffee and one dozen steel State v. Niranjan Kumar & others utensils, one godrej Almirah and cash of Rs.1.5 lakhs in the marriage of their daughter as per their own wish.
But despite giving the said articles and cash, all the accused persons used to give beatings to her daughter Priyanka.
4. On 12.09.2019, at about 09.08 PM, a call was received from someone at 100 number that at H.No. 227, Veena Enclave, near Prayag Bharti School, one lady had committed suicide.

Thereafter,
PCR officials took the deceased to Sonia hospital but they could not admit the patient and then, they took the deceased to Sanjay Gandhi hospital, where the doctor had declared the patient brought dead.
Thereafter, father of accused Niranjan Kumar made a call to the family members of deceased and informed that Priyanka had expired and her dead body was in Sanjay Gandhi hospital.

She further stated that her son-in-law used to come in the night at about 12 O'clock and whenever they asked him to talk with their daughter, he used to decline and also used to beat their daughter after consuming liquor.

5. During investigation, postmortem of the dead body of deceased Priyanka got conducted vide PM No. 894/2019 and State v. Niranjan Kumar & others thereafter, the body of deceased was handed over to her relatives.
During investigation, all the accused persons were arrested and their disclosure statements were recorded wherein they disclosed their involvement in the present offence.
6. During investigation, site plan was prepared by the IO and the exhibits were sent to FSL, Rohini for expert opinion.

On 18.10.2019, subsequent opinion regarding ligature material was collected wherein below mentioned opinion was given :
"After going through PM no. 894/2019 and examining the ligature material, ligature mark present on the neck of deceased is possible with the ligature material examined or similar one."

7. During investigation, inquiry was made from the neighbourhood and it was revealed that Suman who is sister-in-law of deceased used to come in the house of her parental house oftenly and they never saw Suman quarreling with the deceased.
Hence, she was kept in column no. 12.

However,
accused Seema and Kamla could not be arrested.

8. Thereafter, on 22.01.2021, supplementary charge sheet qua accused Kamla Devi and Seema were filed.
